name: Texture-Encoded Isosurfacing
definition: An alternate solution that renders fewer faces per tetrahedron by using the decomposition step of the PT algorithm to create smaller tetrahedra instead of triangles.
summary: Texture-Encoded Isosurfacing extracts isosurfaces from unstructured grids by projecting decomposed tetrahedra and using 2D checkerboard textures to compute intersections via hardware.
